protocol.hypothesis: For the fixed 4H Dual ZigZag price/RSI trend rule, requiring the breakout close to clear the confirmed price pivot by 0.25, 0.5 or 1.0 previous-bar ATR(14) may reduce weak false-breakout losing trades. Test on both parent timeframes without retuning its price wing 5, deviation 2%, RSI 14 or exit. Measure lost winners as well as losers.

research_provenance.implementation: new ATR confirmation, not from the author; exact frozen parent signal is the k=0 control

required_data: ATR(14) from previous completed signal bars
protocol.availability_lag: The parent signal uses confirmed pivots. ATR uses only 14 bars closed before the breakout signal bar. Decision at signal close; execution next open.
protocol.signal_semantics: Per-stock long/short signal from closed 1H or 4H bar; next open execution; no historical pivot-marker entry.
protocol.evaluation_unit: Independent per-stock experimental account; one common parameter setting chosen by early ranking for paper review.

entry_design.confirmation: Parent 5-bar price and RSI swing; k=0,0.25,0.5,1.0
not_applicable: ATR alone has no directional entry signal
changing stops or holding period in this confirmation experiment

protocol.parameter_rationale: One-sided minimum breakout distance in units of previous 14-bar ATR: zero reproduces parent, 0.25/0.5/1 span weak to strong breakouts; fixed before result inspection.
protocol.baseline: One 25% long buy-and-hold position on the same stock/timeframe; atr_0 is the fixed parent control.
protocol.signal_rule: Compute frozen dual_5_2_14_trend-opp event. Before incorporating current-bar pivot confirmations, read last known price high/low. For k>0 keep long only if close - last high >= k*ATR14 from prior completed bars; keep short only if last low - close >= k*ATR14. No delayed re-entry. Exit/reverse on opposite retained event.
protocol.execution_timing: Decision on completed bar; fill next open; 25% of equity per position.
protocol.rebalance_rule: At new signal or exit only
protocol.cost_status: after_30bps_round_trip_transaction_cost_equivalent; excludes dividends, short borrow and exchange lots
protocol.selection: Research comparison only; do not change existing live paper accounts from this test. Compare filter to atr_0 on identical symbol/timeframe/month pairs and inspect losing/winning trades, long/short, PnL, drawdown and >20% target.
limitations: Latest history was already viewed in parent experiment.
ATR alone has no directional entry signal.
Corporate actions and short borrow are not fully covered.

validation.note: DATA_READY confirms data and report gates only; it does not approve a trading strategy.
